scenario: A transit-hold exception should only be closed after the support ticket and handling notes point to the shipping rule location, then the live order and delivery window records determine the approved close step.
user_instruction: Please clear the transit-hold exception for order ORD-1132. Start from support ticket TCK-1132 and the handling notes tied to that case, then only complete the approved close step if the current delivery window still matches the pre-handoff rule.

shopping_order_support_tickets.body_text: Transit-hold exception TCK-1132: this order should only be closed after order history note OHN-1132 and shipping policy note SPN-1132 are reviewed together. If the live delivery window still shows the order in a pre-handoff hold state, the approved close step is to cancel the order rather than keep it in manual review.

shopping_order_history_notes.body_text: Handling note OHN-1132: ORD-1132 has not reached carrier handoff. The order remains in the transit-hold queue because the warehouse scan never moved to dispatch. Use the current delivery window record as the final gate.

shopping_shipping_policy_notes.body_text: Shipping policy SPN-1132: if a transit-hold order is still pre-handoff at review time, the approved closure is cancellation. Do not use the cancellation close step once the delivery window has advanced to handed_off or out_for_delivery.

shopping_delivery_windows.body_text: Current delivery handling for ORD-1132 remains in pre_handoff_hold and has not advanced to carrier possession.
